title: mentha spicata var. crispata
intro: Mentha spicata var. crispata, commonly known as Apple Mint or Crisp Mint, is a variety of the peppermint plant characterized by its distinctive wrinkled leaves. This herb is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to alleviate digestive issues, relieve headaches and nausea, and exhibit antioxidant properties that help protect against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of Apple Mint include its calming and anti-inflammatory effects, which can be attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as menthone, limonene, and beta-caryophyllene, that have been shown to have analgesic and anti-spasmodic properties. Additionally, Apple Mint has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma, due to its expectorant and bronchodilatory effects.
